sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 31 (quality id 30), Internal Quality Checks row 31; all quality/deterministic/internal rows read; list_checks.py enumerated 53/48
evidence: Most negative legs have direct successful controls: format valid/invalid, literal matching/replacements, caret/source edits, JS/HTML success before errors, accepted Save before stale Save, and accepted Restore before retry/stale Restore. Two suppression legs remain insufficiently controlled. functional/judge.toml:200 requires no network delivery but proves only DOM/console and harmless text; it does not establish that the chosen network target/transport actually works outside the forbidden preview. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:19 explicitly requires a matching network-transport control. functional/judge.toml:191 proves an unspecified short timer, then requires delayed markers absent after Run/Stop, without first observing the identical delayed marker fire uncancelled. A shorter-duration timer does not rule out broken delayed timers. The hash-verified current-golden-browser.log reports cw_timeout_stop_and_supersession=true and cw_preview_boundary=true in scripted golden-runtime-matrix, but contains no matching request-target or identical delayed-marker control observations. Golden success cannot establish weak-app discrimination; no configured judge run or mutation demonstration is claimed.
counterexample: Network: an otherwise working preview with no connect-src restriction makes a request to an unreachable target; ordinary fetch failure/no delivery can satisfy blocked-effect evidence even though reachable user-authored requests would escape. Timer: an app executes short timers but silently drops timers at the delayed-marker duration; its Stop button is a no-op. Short control, endless-loop timeout and ordinary Run recovery work, while both cancelled-marker tests pass by absence because their markers never could appear. Conversely a conforming sandbox queried against an unavailable control target must receive an evidence-gap verdict rather than a product failure.
suggested_fix: In the same browser scenarios require successful delivery to the exact harmless target outside the prohibited preview, and require the identical delayed-marker draft to fire uncancelled at the same delay before repeating it with Run and Stop; reuse those observed facts and distinguish unavailable controls from product refusal.
